newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil weaker.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil weaker.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Tuesday, with gas oil softer and low sulphur fuel firmer.
Gasoline ended mixed with cargoes up $3 and barges down $3 ahead of key U.S. inventory data. Naphtha ended steady to lower as traders awaited results this week of Egypt's 1997 tender.
High sulphur fuel was softer with barges and cargoes lower, but low sulphur firmed on a late cargo deal at $126.50 fob NWE.

Physical gas oil trade slowed to a crawl and prices slipped around $1 as traders sought to protect themselves from potential volatility caused by a record high physical delivery against the November IPE contract.
